description: Escape hatch that executes ANY of the 169 Yandex KIT API operations by operationId, including operations without a dedicated tool. WARNING: this performs REAL calls against the live store — write operations (create/update/delete/archive) take effect immediately and there is no sandbox. Workflow: search_operations -> get_operation_schema -> kit_request. The request body is validated against the OpenAPI schema before sending (set validate=false to skip).

body.description: JSON request body; get the exact shape from get_operation_schema("<OperationId>")

operation_id.description: Operation id in PascalCase, e.g. "GetProducts" (find it via search_operations)

path_params.description: Values for {placeholders} in the path, e.g. {"id": "123"}

query.description: Query-string parameters (e.g. page, per_page for paginated lists)

validate.description: Validate body against the OpenAPI schema before sending (default true)

name: kit_request
title: Execute any KIT API operation
